review.decision: Cover storage changes across tabs, responsive layout changes and image-specific resource refusal.
review.notes: Use ordinary paired, guest and signed-out browser states. Hold a synthetic content read to observe cleanup. Supply normal small image bytes and over-budget metadata. Authentication or content integrity errors still retire or fail the document.

cases.description: Private previews follow browser credential and view lifetimes
cases.setup: Two pages on the same synthetic workspace origin and a delayed registered document response.
cases.action: Switch the stored credential to a guest and then sign out. Reopen the document each time. Separately cross the responsive breakpoint during a pending read.
cases.expected: The previous viewer closes and late bytes cannot render. New requests use the current identity or prompt for pairing. A layout transition leaves no stranded pending reader.

cases.description: The reader skips a local image outside the remaining budget
cases.setup: Synthetic HTML with two declared PNG sources. One related image reports a length above the per-image budget.
cases.action: Open the HTML and observe image requests and the rendered document. Separately refuse related image access.
cases.expected: The over-budget body is never requested. Verified text and the other image render. Permission refusal still fails the whole reader.
